name: Pillow with decoration of a boy
summary: Ceramic pillow of trapezoidal form, the top surface decorated with incised design of a boy grasping a Buddhist implement amid billowing scarves; diapered floral patterning impressed on the side walls; buff earthenware with emerald green and amber brown lead fluxed glazes over incised, molded, and slip-painted decoration.
